outcome: Seroprevalence of anti-HSV-2 IgG and IgM antibodies
cohort: 100 hospitalized children under five years old in Iraq
finding: The seroprevalence of HSV-2 infection was high in Iraqi children under five, with 35% having IgG antibodies and 17% having IgM antibodies.
mod_finding: Normal vaginal delivery was the mode of birth for 63% of children.
gest_age: 75% of children were born full term
